title: Confounding Compounding
supportedClaims: Compounding looks magical only because the most important variable is usually duration, not brilliance.
Small edges repeated for a very long time build results that outsiders later misread as genius or unique insight.
The chapter pushes readers to protect time horizon, avoid interruption, and value consistency over dramatic but fragile moves.
caution: Compounding is powerful, but only for people who survive boredom, setbacks, and the urge to reset the clock.
